<action type="say">
Here’s a script you can more or less read from when you call.

Opening / request
“Hi, I’d like to see if you have availability for a reservation.  
I’m looking for a table for 5 people on Saturday the 31st at 7:30 pm.  
If 7:30 isn’t available, do you have anything between 7:30 and 8:30?”

If they offer a time you like
“Great, I’ll take [repeat the time they offer].  
Can I make that under the name [Your Name], and the contact number is [Your Phone Number]?”

Vegetarian questions
“One person in our group is vegetarian, so I’d like to double-check your options:  

• Do you have clearly vegetarian dishes on the menu with no meat, fish, or shellfish?  
• Are there any vegetarian sushi rolls or hot dishes (like noodles or rice) you can recommend?  
• Are any of your broths or sauces made with fish or meat stock that we should be aware of?  
• If needed, could the kitchen prepare something fully vegetarian?”

Clarify “vegetarian” if needed
“When you say vegetarian, that doesn’t include fish or fish stock, correct?”

Final confirmation
“Perfect, thank you. So I’m confirmed for 5 people on Saturday the 31st at [confirmed time] under [Your Name].  
And you’ve confirmed that there will be at least one fully vegetarian-friendly option available that night, right?”

If 7:30 is not available
If they say no to 7:30 from the start:

“Okay, what times do you have available for 5 people between 7:00 and 8:30?”  
[Pick what works]  
“Great, I’ll take [time], under [Your Name], number [Your Phone Number].”  
[Then ask the vegetarian questions above.]

If you tell me any extra constraints (e.g., no egg, no dairy, no alcohol in sauces), I can tighten those vegetarian questions for you.</action>
